result.summary: The eighth trigger search was performed over a scope explicitly disjoint from the seventh round. Component 1 (full-text near-miss reading) fetched and read the full public text (or, where unavailable, the abs page and metadata) of the one seventh-round near-miss whose frozen-gate verdict was settled at abstract level only (C2, Andrews-Kumar-Rai arXiv:2511.05035), and recorded assessment-and-decline for the five whose abstract-level verdicts were conclusive (C1, C3, C4, C5, C6). The C2 reading revealed the paper is WITHDRAWN (v2, 2026-01-27) with a referee-noted proof gap in Theorems 6.2 and 6.4, and its full text is genuinely unavailable (HTML and PDF views 404), strengthening its rejection. Component 2 (internal-corpus correspondence search) opened the P1553 object records (H-CREP-001, IDEA-20260723-001, DEC-20260722-002, EV-ECDLP-002, EXP-CREP-001) and found only pointers to the open constructor obligation, no typed construction. Component 3 (new areas) performed bounded network retrieval over function-field, algebraic-geometry, and transfer-theoretic circuit identities and recurrences; all searches returned 0 results or off-topic results. Every candidate considered is judged item-by-item against the frozen gate (G1-G8); none passes every item. The honest disposition is scoped_no_candidate.
result.preserved_scope: No B71 admission, experiment, evidence, ECDLP attack, speedup, novelty, closure, SOTA movement, or breakthrough is claimed. The coordinate-aware P1553 target-local remainder transducer and the exact dyadic subinterval unit-product interface, and every broader preserved route (including function-field, algebraic-geometry, and transfer-theoretic identities as open resources), remain open under their exact narrow boundaries. Pollard rho remains the realized frontier.
